question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

An arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present
solution:
The correct answer is 'bouquet'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning and example of the given options:

 
 
• **wreathe**(verb)- "to cover or surround something". (किसी चीज को ढकना या घेरना)

 
 
• *E.g.* *The peak of the mountain is perpetually **wreathed **in cloud.*
 
 
 
• **garland**(noun)- "a circle made of flowers and leaves worn around the neck or head as a decoration". (सजावट के रूप में गले या सिर के चारों ओर पहने जाने वाले फूलों और पत्तियों से बना एक चक्र)
 
 
• *E.g. They were dressed in white and wore **garlands **that seemed to shine.*
 
 
 
• *​***bouquet**(noun)- "a group of flowers that have been attractively arranged so that they can be given as a present or carried on a formal occasion". (फूलों का एक समूह जिसे आकर्षक ढंग से व्यवस्थित किया गया है ताकि उन्हें उपहार के रूप में दिया जा सके या औपचारिक अवसर पर ले जाया जा सके)
 
 
• *E.g.* *Chris sent me a lovely **bouquet **when I was sick.*
 
 
 
• *​***blossom**(noun)- "a small flower, or the small flowers on a tree or plant". (एक छोटा फूल, या एक पेड़ या पौधे पर छोटे फूल)
 
 
• *E.g.* *The scent of apple **blossom **filled the air.*
 
 
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that 'bouquet' is the most appropriate word for the given group of words.
